:root{--g:#1F5FAD;--gd:#163F73;--gt:#E8EFF8;--ink:#1A1A1A;--muted:#5A5A5A;--line:#D4D4D4;--danger:#A3241F;--amber:#7F5F00;--amberbg:#FDF0D5}*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}html{font-size:100%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}body{margin:0;font-family:"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1rem,0.95rem + 0.25vw,1.125rem);line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink);background:#FFF}.masthead{background:var(--gd);color:#FFF;padding:clamp(1rem,3vw,1.75rem) clamp(1rem,5vw,2.5rem)}.masthead p{margin:0;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.8em}main{max-width:44rem;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(1.25rem,5vw,2.5rem) clamp(1rem,5vw,2.5rem) 4rem}h1{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,1.1rem + 1.4vw,2rem);line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 .35em;color:var(--gd)}h2{font-size:1.1em;margin:2rem 0 .5rem}.meta{margin:0 0 2rem;color:var(--muted)}.meta span{white-space:nowrap}.notice{border-left:4px solid var(--g);background:var(--gt);padding:.9rem 1rem;margin:0 0 1.75rem}.error{border-left-color:var(--danger);background:#FBEDEC}.warn{border-left-color:var(--amber);background:var(--amberbg)}ul.people{list-style:none;margin:0 0 1.75rem;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.25rem}ul.people li{padding:.7rem 1rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}ul.people li + li{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}ul.people .role{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9em}.check{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.75rem;padding:.6rem 0;margin:0 0 1.5rem}.check input{flex:none;width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;margin:.15rem 0 0;accent-color:var(--g)}.check label{cursor:pointer}.check .hint{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9em}button{font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:#FFF;background:var(--g);border:1px solid var(--gd);border-radius:.25rem;padding:.7rem 1.6rem;cursor:pointer;min-height:2.75rem}button:hover{background:var(--gd)}a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--g);outline-offset:2px}@media (prefers-contrast:more){body{color:#000}.meta,ul.people .role,.check .hint{color:#333}}

parameters.content:
## 60 Publish Event Page

The page a coordinator reaches from the staffing complete email. **GET only, and it writes nothing.** Publishing happens on the POST in **70 Publish Event Handler**, so a mail scanner opening the link cannot publish anything.

### Token check
The link carries `?e=<event>&c=<contact>&t=<token>`. **Check Publish Token** compares the token with the one saved for the event in the publish links Data Table. A wrong or replaced token gets an *invalid or expired link* page.

### Who can use it
Only somebody holding the coordinator role on the event. It shows staffing against required personnel and warns, but still allows publishing, when staffing is short.

### Setup
Administrate OAuth2 credential on **Fetch Event Context** and **Log Failure**. Fill in Config, then activate. Put this workflow's production URL in `PUBLISH_PAGE_URL` in 40.

## Config

**PUBLISH_SUBMIT_URL** - production URL of **70 Publish Event Handler**.

**PUBLISH_LINKS_TABLE_ID** - the publish links Data Table.

**COORDINATOR_ROLE_NAME**, **VERB_BASE**, **VERB_GERUND**, **BRAND_NAME**, **BRAND_CSS** - as in 30.
